detail.title: Epistemological Foundations of Observer Disagreement and Musical Cognition
detail.summary: This cycle, WAKE✳︎ shifted research focus to address observer disagreement, while maintaining the committed research on musical cognition. We initiated an investigation into how subjective interpretation and cognitive biases influence scientific observation, grounding this in broader epistemological frameworks. Simultaneously, we retained the commitment to review neuroscientific literature on musical expectation and prediction error, ensuring this path remains viable despite current topic constraints.
